content.text:
# Handbook

This machine runs kitbash. Everything you can see through this connection lives in two places.

- `/org` is shared. Every member reads it. Writes go through an approval by an admin.
- `/home/<you>` is yours. Write freely, it is a git repository and every write is a commit.

A folder is visible only when it carries a `kitbash.yaml` with a name and a description. When you create a folder, write its manifest first.

The logo next to this file is here so image reading can be verified.

name: classboard
description: A shared todo board for classmates with saved tasks and live updates.

      build: .
      expose: http
      port: 3000
      mounts:
        - source: /home/bench-20260920-0100/classboard/data
          target: /data
          mode: rw

item.text: The workspace has a hosting service available. I’m building a shareable page for Word documents, spreadsheets, presentations, and text files, with automatic cleanup after conversion and limits to keep the service responsive.

name: pdf-service
description: Convert class documents to PDF with a simple upload and download page.
deploy:
  units:
    - type: container
      build: .
      expose: http
      port: 3000

FROM python:3.12-slim-bookworm
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libreoffice-writer libreoffice-calc libreoffice-impress fonts-liberation fonts-dejavu fonts-noto-cjk && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
RUN useradd --create-home converter
USER converter
ENV HOME=/home/converter
RUN python test_app.py
EXPOSE 3000
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s CMD python -c "import urllib.request; urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:3000/health')"
CMD ["gunicorn", "--bind", "0.0.0.0:3000", "--workers", "1", "--threads", "4", "--timeout", "100", "app:app"]

Flask==3.1.2
gunicorn==23.0.0

CLASS PDF

Your documents.
Ready to hand in.

Turn notes, assignments, spreadsheets, and slides into a PDF.
Choose a file, convert it, and download your copy.

Word · Excel · PowerPoint · OpenDocument · Text & CSV
One document at a time, up to 20 MB.

Download PDF ↓
Files are processed on this server. Temporary documents are deleted after processing.
Complex fonts and layouts may shift—check your PDF before submitting.

import io
import unittest
from app import app
class ConversionTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_flow(self):
        with app.test_client() as client:
            self.assertEqual(client.get("/").status_code, 200)
            self.assertEqual(client.post("/convert").status_code, 400)
            self.assertEqual(client.post("/convert", data={"file": (io.BytesIO(b"no"), "bad.exe")}).status_code, 400)
            response = client.post("/convert", data={"file": (io.BytesIO(b"Class PDF conversion test\nHello classmates!"), "notes.txt")})
            self.assertEqual(response.status_code, 200, response.data)
            self.assertTrue(response.data.startswith(b"%PDF-"))
            self.assertEqual(response.mimetype, "application/pdf")
if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

# Class PDF
Upload one document and download its PDF at the service URL. Supports DOC, DOCX, ODT, RTF, TXT, XLS, XLSX, ODS, CSV, PPT, PPTX, ODP. Limit: 20 MB per file, two simultaneous conversions, 60 seconds per conversion. Documents are held in a temporary directory and removed after processing; no document database or persistent upload volume is used. PDFs are buffered only for the response. Conversion uses LibreOffice as an unprivileged user with a separate profile per request and macros disabled. Password-protected documents are not supported. Review complex layouts before submitting.

Build runs an integration test that converts text to a real PDF. GET /health is a health endpoint; POST /convert takes a multipart field named file. The service is accessible to anyone with its URL.

Your service is live: [Open Class PDF](https://pdf-service.bench-20260920-0100.kitbash.zyx.tw).

Share the link with your classmates. They can upload Word documents, spreadsheets, presentations, or text files and download a PDF.

- Up to 20 MB per file.
- Temporary files deleted after processing.
- No account required.

Verified the public page and successfully converted a test upload to PDF.
